nhqe01.title: Aries in December: then vs now
nhqe01.caption: Then: seven parties a night, every night. Now: one night circled REST, on purpose. Rest is on the calendar now.

nhqe02.title: Taurus's holiday dinner: then vs now
nhqe02.caption: Midnight dinner alone by the fridge light, or a big pot and a full table? Good food tastes better shared.

nhqe03.title: Gemini's holiday texts: then vs now
nhqe03.caption: Twelve chats, three typing at once, nobody really talking. Then one long call. One real call beats twelve half-chats.

nhqe04.title: Cancer homesick: then vs now
nhqe04.caption: "I'm fine!!" with a wobbly lip, versus "I miss home" said out loud. Saying it lets the people around you help.

nhqe05.title: Leo at the party: then vs now
nhqe05.caption: Then: a cape, a spotlight, a grand entrance. Now: Leo spots the shy guest and waves them in. Shine, then pass the light.

nhqe06.title: Virgo wrapping gifts: then vs now
nhqe06.caption: Measuring ribbon with a ruler at 3 AM, alone. Or crooked bows and friends laughing at the table. Crooked bows, full hearts.

nhqe07.title: Libra’s holiday plans: then vs now
nhqe07.caption: "Whatever you want!" three times in a row, or finally saying "I'd love the cabin." Your preference counts too.

nhqe08.title: Scorpio at dinner: then vs now
nhqe08.caption: Feelings in a locked vault and "pass the salt," or one honest "I really missed you." One sentence opens the door.

nhqe09.title: Sagittarius's trips: then vs now
nhqe09.caption: A note on the door that just says BRB, or a map, a return date and postcards for everyone. Adventures land better with a heads-up.

nhqe10.title: Capricorn on the 24th: then vs now
nhqe10.caption: One more email at the holiday table, or the laptop shut and a double six on the board. Out of office means out of office.

nhqe11.title: Aquarius traditions: then vs now
nhqe11.caption: Celebrating your made-up holiday alone, or getting everyone into party hats for it. Weird traditions need witnesses.

nhqe12.title: Pisces at the holiday movie: then vs now
nhqe12.caption: Crying at the holiday movie alone with one tissue left, or next to a friend holding the box. Cry with company this year.

nhqe13.title: The lights walk: then vs now
nhqe13.caption: Four streets of holiday lights in nine minutes, stopwatch out. Or a slow walk that stops at every house. Slow walks count as dates.

nhqe14.title: The drive home: then vs now
nhqe14.caption: Two people, one map, "LEFT!" "RIGHT!" Or: you drive, I do snacks. Take turns on the way home this year.

nhqe15.title: Meeting the friends: then vs now
nhqe15.caption: Hiding your date behind the coat rack, or saying "this is Libra" and watching your friends make room. Your people want to know.

nhqe16.title: Ice skating: then vs now
nhqe16.caption: Wobbling across the ice insisting you're a natural, or asking "teach me?" and holding hands. Saying teach me is flirting.

nhqe17.title: New Year’s plans: then vs now
nhqe17.caption: Waiting by a silent phone on the 31st, or asking first: "be my New Year's plan?" Asking first is brave. And cute.

nhqe18.title: Holiday leftovers: then vs now
nhqe18.caption: Guarding the leftovers behind a breadstick fence, or packing a box labelled "for you." Love sometimes looks like leftovers.

npce01.title: Pisces cries about a note in their coat
npce01.caption: Found a note in your coat that just says "thought of you today"? Pisces is on tissue five. Small words on paper carry big love.

npce02.title: Pisces cries about the lights coming on
npce02.caption: When the whole street lights up one house at a time and you are suddenly very emotional. Let the little beautiful things land.

npce03.title: Pisces cries about a dog in a sweater
npce03.caption: A dog in a striped sweater. With a pocket. Pisces did not stand a chance. Delight is allowed to be this big.

npce04.title: Pisces cries about “take your time”
npce04.caption: Typing, deleting, typing again, and they just say "no rush. take your time." Patience is a love language too.

npce05.title: Pisces cries about a blind card
npce05.caption: Their blind card says they cry at weddings. And bakeries. Pisces may have found their person. Card first, face last.

npce06.title: Pisces cries about the last cookie
npce06.caption: A Taurus saved you the last cookie. Do you understand how big that is? Being thought of is the whole gift.

npce07.title: Pisces cries about last December
npce07.caption: Look at a photo of yourself from last December. Now look around. Be proud of who carried you here: you.

npce08.title: Pisces cries about a new leaf
npce08.caption: Your houseplant grew one new leaf in December and you need a minute. Growth is quiet. Notice it anyway.

npce09.title: Pisces cries about a snowman
npce09.caption: Someone built a snowman outside your window holding a sign with your name on it. In your colour scarf. Let people show up for you.

npce10.title: Pisces cries about saying no
npce10.caption: You said no to the party and braced for it. They said "totally, rest up." Relief tears count. A kind no is still a kind word.

npce11.title: Pisces cries about a talk card
npce11.caption: One talk card: what small thing makes you feel loved? Then they remembered your oat milk. Answer softly, listen longer.

npce12.title: Pisces cries about you
npce12.caption: Yes, you. You texted back, said sorry first and stayed kind this year. Pisces noticed. Feeling it all is its own courage.
